answer: An identity must be at least 2 epochs old on the violet ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the orchard checkpoint rather than self-declared, the vertex audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm therefore means funding each duplicate self through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. That is 10 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
